description: This file defines the client-side chat interface logic for a web application, including message handling, command parsing, queue management, and avatar updates.

classes.name: ChatHost
classes.description: Represents the state and configuration of a chat session, including client info, messages, attachments, session details, and callbacks.

methods.name: isChatBusy
methods.description: Checks if the chat host is currently busy (sending or has an active run).

methods.name: isChatStopCommand
methods.description: Determines if a given text is a command to stop or abort the chat.

methods.name: handleAbortChat
methods.description: Handles aborting the current chat session if connected.

methods.name: enqueueChatMessage
methods.description: Adds a message with optional attachments and commands to the chat queue.

methods.name: enqueuePendingRunMessage
methods.description: Adds a message indicating a pending run with a specific run ID.

methods.name: sendChatMessageNow
methods.description: Sends a chat message immediately, handling UI updates and queue management.

methods.name: flushChatQueue
methods.description: Processes the chat message queue, dispatching messages or commands.

methods.name: removeQueuedMessage
methods.description: Removes a specific message from the chat queue by ID.

methods.name: clearPendingQueueItemsForRun
methods.description: Removes queued messages associated with a specific run ID.

methods.name: handleSendChat
methods.description: Main handler for sending chat messages, including command parsing and queueing.

methods.name: dispatchSlashCommand
methods.description: Executes specific slash commands, including session control and model updates.

methods.name: clearChatHistory
methods.description: Resets the chat history and session state.

methods.name: injectCommandResult
methods.description: Inserts a system message into the chat messages array.

methods.name: refreshChat
methods.description: Reloads chat history, sessions, avatar, and models, optionally scheduling UI scroll.

methods.name: refreshChatModels
methods.description: Loads available chat models and updates the catalog.

methods.name: refreshChatAvatar
methods.description: Fetches and updates the avatar URL for the current session.

methods.name: resolveAgentIdForSession
methods.description: Determines the agent ID associated with the current session key.

methods.name: buildAvatarMetaUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL to fetch avatar metadata based on base path and agent ID.
